name: com.streethawk.library.location.StreethawkLocationService
description: This component is part of the StreetHawk mobile engagement SDK. StreetHawk starts this older Service when location collection is enabled. It selects a device location provider and sends coordinate updates to StreetHawk, using different intervals while the app is foreground or background.
disableEffect: StreetHawk location history and location-based campaign reports will stop updating.
